title: kbmon --events splits free text with a comma in any coord field into id pieces
goal: mon_events.id_list splits a comma-separated value only in the coord id fields it documents (item, topic, touch), so a free-text value with a comma in another field is dropped as before, not exported in pieces

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_events as m;r=m.attributes(m.id_list({'note':'Hello, world','item':'ST-aaaaaaaa,ST-bbbbbbbb'}));print(r);sys.exit(1 if any(k.startswith('note') for k in r) or 'item_n' not in r else 0)
